purpose: Measure rather than assume the topology-motion trade-off over late H8 training.

conditioning: prompt-level real/generated motion-profile correlation and normalized MAE
reporting.selection_rule: Report all four checkpoints. Prefer a Pareto-nondominated topology/motion checkpoint; if several are effectively tied, prefer the earlier checkpoint. Do not select by validation flow MSE alone.
reporting.claim_limit: One training seed and one fixed evaluation seed set support checkpoint diagnosis, not a universal convergence law.
